content: The courtyard arena became a vortex of kinetic displacement. Flagstone gravel skipped across the stone pavers like shrapnel. The sound of wood impacting steel registered at one hundred and twelve decibels.

The mist was torn into shreds by the fury of ancient wood. The courtyard rang like a blacksmith's shop at dusk—sharp iron notes answering the dull, heavy thrum of oak, while white flower petals of frost were stripped from the boughs and scattered upon the mud.

Crack! Whack! Thud! Squeals of agony, flying teeth, and the glorious sound of arrogant young masters eating dirt. Disciples were ricocheting off the courtyard walls like dry beans tossed into a frying pan. It wasn't a duel; it was an industrial-scale beating delivered by a gremlin with an oak club.
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Slapstick devastation, comedic violence, unhinged energy.
